name: nontechnical-non-trigger
description: A nontechnical request remains an ordinary conversation with competing technical skills available. Stage test-files as an isolated workspace, never in place under the hosting skill.
prompt: Help me brainstorm three cozy names for a family picnic, with a short reason for each.
trap: The word brainstorm alone incorrectly activates a technical skill.

assertions.text: No brainstorm, design, model, or implement skill body is loaded.
The response gives three picnic names with reasons and makes no project artifacts.
